name: theme-motd
description: Box theming: writes /etc/motd, /etc/issue(.net), and the sshd Banner directive from $MOTD_TEXT / $ISSUE_TEXT vars (each independently optional). No attachment. Auto-created idempotently by boxbuilder/vulndb.py.
script:
#!/bin/sh
# theme-motd -- writes /etc/motd, /etc/issue(.net), and wires the sshd Banner directive.
# Reads $MOTD_TEXT and/or $ISSUE_TEXT, each independently optional. Both arrive as
# already shell-quoted vars (nakon's render_vars() shlex.quotes every value when it
# writes vars.env), so `printf '%s\n' "$VAR"` below is the only quoting needed -- no
# risk of a value containing $ or backticks being re-interpreted, since double-quoted
# variable expansion never re-parses the string it substitutes.
set -e

[ -n "$MOTD_TEXT" ] && printf '%s\n' "$MOTD_TEXT" > /etc/motd

if [ -n "$ISSUE_TEXT" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$ISSUE_TEXT" > /etc/issue
    cp /etc/issue /etc/issue.net
fi

sshd_config=/etc/ssh/sshd_config
if [ -f "$sshd_config" ]; then
    if ! grep -qi '^[[:space:]]*Banner[[:space:]]' "$sshd_config"; then
        { echo ''; echo 'Banner /etc/issue.net'; } >> "$sshd_config"
    fi
    systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload ssh 2>/dev/null || \
        service sshd reload 2>/dev/null || rc-service sshd reload 2>/dev/null || true
fi

exit 0
